what: PPG makes paints and coatings: automotive paint applied in car factories and body shops, protective coatings for ships, bridges and aircraft, industrial coatings, and architectural paint sold in several markets.
customers: Carmakers and body shops, aerospace and marine customers, industrial manufacturers, and painting contractors.
money: refinish, aerospace, protective, marine and architectural coatings
automotive original equipment, packaging and industrial coatings
moat: Coatings qualified into carmakers' and aircraft manufacturers' production processes, where changing supplier means requalification and risk to the finish.
risks: Revenue was flat last year and roughly flat over three years
European industrial demand has been weak
Car production volumes have been falling in Europe
opportunities: Gross margin of 41% with a 14% operating margin
Aerospace coatings demand is strong with aircraft production rising
Cost reduction and portfolio disposals have simplified the company
watch: Organic volume growth by segment and raw material costs.
